thread:
rachel: Heads up  NovaScale (NS-881) reports they were under-credited during last month's pricing experiment. We ran 'commit-discount' A/B and they expected 10% off reserved hours for 4/1-4/07 but invoice INV-2026-04-12 shows only a 5% credit. Can finance take a look?

marta: Can you paste the invoice line + expected vs billed amounts?

rachel: INV-2026-04-12 line: reserved_gpu_hours: 720 hrs @ $0.75 = $540. Expected commit-discount 10% -> $54 credit. Billed credit was $27 (5%) so net overcharge $27.

dave: I pulled experiment assignment logs. Looks like NS-881 got assigned twice due to a retry path in the exp service; the billing pipeline dedup kept the 5% variant. Snippet: ```2026-04-02T05:14:03Z WARN exp-assign: duplicate assignment NS-881 exp=commit-discount v1=10 v2=5 retry=1 id=xyz```

billing-bot: Ticket FIN-4850 created to track NovaScale retro credit; linked INV-2026-04-12.

marta: System-caused promo mismatch -> eligible for retro credit. Recommend issuing the missing $27. Any goodwill?

rachel: NovaScale is a steady mid-market customer. They've asked only for a clear remediation note. No goodwill required.

alex: I can approve up to $50 for quick customer fixes. $27 is OK. Need a short ledger justification and GL.

marta: Ledger note: "Experiment assignment duplication caused incorrect discount rate applied; issued additional retro promo credit $27 to correct commit-discount for 4/1-4/7. Approved by finance lead alex." GL: SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026.

alex: Approved.

marta: Creating credit memo CM-2026-071 for $27, attaching FIN-4850 and applying to INV-2026-04-12. Posting to ledger under SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026.

billing-bot: CM-2026-071 created and applied to INV-2026-04-12. Invoice balance adjusted.

dave: I'll patch the experiment-assignment service to be idempotent on retries and add a daily audit job to surface multiple assignments. Opening PR and linking to FIN-4850.

marta: Please add the audit query and runbook steps to FIN-4850 for audit evidence.

rachel: Notified customer; they confirmed receipt and appreciate the quick fix.

alex: Mark FIN-4850 resolved once PR + runbook are attached. Nice work.

marta: FIN-4850 moved to resolved; CM-2026-071 attached; invoice notes updated. Closing loop.

rachel: Thanks team :handshake:
